text:
One day I went outside to the big meadow. I met a small bunny near a tree. The bunny looked sad and it was not moving. I saw the reason why it was stuck. Its foot was trapped in a twisted vine. I thought about what to do. I ran inside to get my big orange scissors. I left my computer game on the table.

"Don't worry bunny, I will help you," I said.

I cut the vine and the bunny was free! It hopped away very fast. I believed it was happy.

"You are welcome!" I shouted at the bunny.

I went inside and sent a text to my friend. I told him what happened to the bunny. It was a very good day.

My big sister has a dog named Spot. He wears a brown leather collar. One day we went boating on the lake. The weather was very hot and sunny. Spot was yearning to jump in the water. My sister held his leash tight like a chain. She didn’t want him to get wet.

"Please let him swim," I said.

"No, he is afraid of deep water," she told me.

But then Spot saw a duck and jumped! He splashed around and barked. We laughed and ate toasted sandwiches on the boat. Later the sky cleared up and my dad played his guitar. It was a good day, but Spot smelled like a wet grounding hog. He is a funny dog.

My robot named Zork was acting very weird today. He usually follows a strict schedule, but he was floating upside down. He made a loud thumping sound against the ceiling.

"Get down, Zork!" I yelled at him.

Zork just made a groaning noise and his eyes flashed red. He was dumping all my toys on the floor. I feared he was broken. Then a green light struck him. He started growing bigger and looked like a giant metal lamb. He scratched his head and let out a huge sneeze. Dust spread everywhere.

"Sorry, my coaching circuits are mixed up," Zork beeped.

I laughed and helped him steady himself. His new design was funny, but I liked him anyway.

One sunny day my nephew Billy and I went outside. We crawled through the tall grass in the big meadow. Billy had a big imagination and he believed we were tigers.

"Let's hunt for our dinner!" Billy whispered very loudly to me.

We moved with a slow rhythm like real wild cats. It was a pleasure to be a tiger. Suddenly we saw my dog Rover. He was not trained to be a tiger's dinner. Rover barked and jumped on us and licked our faces.

"I don't think he can understand us," I said laughing.

We went inside and Mom had stewed some carrots for lunch. She didn't have a receipt for the food but it tasted good. Being tigers made us very hungry.

My friends and I went to the twisted forest today. We wanted to find the golden needle in the cave. Tom was complaining about the height of the hill.

"Stop being a baby!" I yelled at him.

"I am not complaining!" Tom yelled back.

We kept walking and saw a huge bear. My heart was pumping fast. We started running away very quickly. Suddenly, a great idea struck me. I stopped running and stood very still.

"We need a meeting right now," I said.

I tried to explain my plan, but the bear roared. That was enough for us. We ran home fast. We didn't find the needle or become a champion today. But we were safe on the grounding. I won't go back there either.

I was playing my new computer game about racing animals. It was so hard and I kept crashing. I picked the elephant because he looked strong. My elephant was running straight on the trail. Suddenly he fell off a big cliff! It looked like he was bungee jumping without a rope.

"Oh no, I crashed again!" I yelled at the screen.

My mom came in and said, "Stop the anger, please."

I tried again and this time I was jumping over rocks. I found a magic water fountain that made me fast. I was keeping my eyes on the finish line. I didn't get dropped behind any longer. I won the race and felt very grateful.

"I thought you were going to lose!" my brother laughed.

"Next time I will pick a different animal," I said.

One morning I woke up very early. My dog Rex was yearning for a walk outside. I looked at the schedule on the fridge. It was my turn to guide him around the block. I put on my shoes and we started leaving the house.

The sun was bright and spread throughout the sky. We saw a squirrel approaching a big oak tree. Rex barked loud and pulled on the leash with all his weight.

"Stop it, Rex!" I yelled. "You will get in trouble."

We kept walking and saw my friend Sam loading his bike.

"Do you want some company?" Sam asked me.

"Yes please," I said. "Rex needs a long walk today."

We walked to the park and I found some safety scissors on the grass. I put them in my pocket. When we got home, I played on my computer. It was a good day.

I went camping with my neighbor named Captain Joe. We walked straight into the dark woods. Captain Joe shook a big stick at a bush. He thought a creature was hiding in there.

"Come out!" he yelled really loud.

Nothing happened for a long time. Then a tiny mouse ran out. It ran over my shoe. Captain Joe looked funny.

"I need a bigger brain," he said.

We laughed and then we ate some snacks. My mom bought us cookies. We felt like kings and it was our reign. The trip was complete when we found a blue thread on the ground. It was a good day.

My birthday party was at the big jump park. I woke up so early because I was excited. My mom made a cake and cut it with a knife. Then my friends came over and we drove to the park.

"I am going on the bungee jump first!" I yelled.

My friend Sam looked scared and feared the high jump. But he tried it and he bounced really high. We touched the ceiling almost.

"That was so fun!" Sam said with a big smile.

Then the man blew a loud whistle for lunch time. Seeing all my friends having fun made me happy. We ate pizza and cake until our tummies hurt. It was the best birthday ever.

Me and my friend Leo climbed the big mountain. We wanted to find the magic gold fountain. It was scary but we had each other for company.

"Look out for the rocks!" shouted Leo loudly.

I was trembling a little bit but I kept going. We counted ten steps and then we saw a cave. The door opened slowly and it made a loud sound. A big green monster jumped out at us!

He struck the ground and roared like a lion. I tried to maintain my brave face for Leo.

"We have to be the champion today!" I yelled.

We ran fast and we tricked the monster. We found the fountain and filled our water bottles. Then we climbed down the mountain again safely. We did a good job keeping our secret treasure.

We went camping for my birthday last weekend. My dad pitched the tent and I helped him. A cool breeze blew my hat off my head. I ran and caught it before it dropped. Then we looked for bugs near the river. I saw a huge black beetle on a rock. It crawled slowly and I tried to catch it.

"Don't touch that bug!" my mom shouted loudly.

We ate hot dogs and sang funny songs together. My dog Spot is trained to sit and stay. He won a treat because he was so good. At night, we closed the tent flap very tight. I hope we can go camping again tomorrow. It is hard to maintain a fire but dad did it. Being with my family is the best thing ever.

I was walking home when I saw a strange green creature. It crawled out of a spaceship in the park. The creature had a shiny silver guitar and wore a leather jacket. He looked very cool but kind of scary too.

"Please listen to my song," said the alien.

He started playing and the music made me feel stronger. Suddenly a big robot came and crushed a bench nearby. The robot was groaning loud noises and loading a laser. The alien threw his guitar at the robot and it caught it.

"That is the greatest throw ever!" I yelled.

Gradually the robot stopped moving and fell over. The alien was honest and nice. He said he was looking for his nephew on Earth. Then he flew away into the sky.

Me and my friend Sam searched for the lost cave. We walked for a long time and grew tired. Suddenly a huge bat flew right at my head! I almost fainted but I stood steady on the rock.

"Look at that big hole!" Sam yelled loudly.

We went inside and it was very dark. A scary spider hung from the ceiling above us. I knew I had to use my brain. I saw a shiny gold crown on a stone.

"Grab it quick!" I shouted to Sam.

He tried to seize the crown but a trap opened. We understood that the cave was magic. The ghost of a king began his reign again. We ran away fast and did not measure how far we went. We were safe but we never went back.

I was playing my new video game called Jungle Jump. It was freezing in my room so I put on a sweater. I picked the monkey character and the level started. I had to squeeze through a tiny cave to get points. Suddenly a big tiger jumped out and chased me! I felt anger because I hate losing lives.

"Watch out for the lava pit!" my brother yelled.

I pressed the jump button hard and my monkey escaped. Then I realized I was hungry so I chewed some gum. I drew my sword and fought the boss snake. I won the level and got a gold trophy.

"Can I play next?" my brother asked me.

"Okay but don't lose my points," I said.

I was so excited for my birthday sleepover. My best friend Sam came over and we played outside. We ran to the big tree in the backyard. There was a nice breeze blowing the leaves around.

"Look at this huge bug!" Sam yelled loudly.

I was afraid it might bite me. I turned around and ran back to the porch. Sam pushed the bug away with a stick. He is never scared of anything.

We went inside and my mom gave us cake. Then we played a game with a chain made of paper. My dog scratched at the door. He wanted to play too but he is too crazy.

"Listen to that thunder," I said to Sam.

We pretended we were dreaming about flying. It was like a bungee jump in the sky. It was the best birthday ever.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the old woods. We were looking for the lost pirate treasure. We walked for a long time and saw a cave.

"I think the gold is in there," said Sam.

He grinned and pointed a finger at the dark hole. We went inside and it smelled like wet dirt. Suddenly, we heard something roaming in the back. It was a big bat hanging from the roof!

The bat screeched and flew right at our heads. We started screaming and running back to the light. Sam gripped my arm very hard. We ran all the way home without stopping. We were not loading our pockets with gold today.

"That was too scary," I said.

Sam nodded and we decided to play video games instead.

I was walking to school and the weather was nice. I saw a huge black beetle on the sidewalk. I poked it with my finger but it didn't move. My friend Sam came running and almost crashed into me.

"Look at that bug!" Sam screamed loudly.

We watched the beetle bearing a big leaf on its back. Then the bell rang and we ran inside. Mrs. Jones was singing a funny song about math. We started earning points for our team by being quiet.

At lunch, I was squeezing my juice box too hard. The juice blew out and went all over Sam's shirt! I thought he would be mad but he just laughed. Having company at lunch is the best part of school. Next time I will be careful loading my tray.

I went outside to my tree fort that I built. I was climbing up the ladder when I saw my cat. He held a tiny mouse in his paws. The mouse was bearing a piece of cheese.

"Put him down, Whiskers!" I yelled very loud.

Whiskers looked at me and he did not move. He felt stronger than me today. I drew a picture of a scary dog on a newspaper. I showed it to Whiskers to scare him away.

"Go away right now!" I said to the cat.

He ran away fast and the mouse was safe. Neither of them came back to my fort that day. I was the king and it was my reign. Then I heard my mom call me for dinner.

I was playing my favorite baseball video game today. My player was a big strong sailor named Bob. He had huge muscles and was swinging a big bat. The pitcher threw the ball fast, and I pressed the button.

"Home run!" I yelled really loud at the TV.

The ball bounced off the wall and crashed into a sign. Then Bob ran fast around all the bases. I checked the schedule to see my next game. I was hungry so I chewed some gum. Then I played again and crushed the other team. I counted my points and discovered a secret bonus level.

"You are winning too much," my brother said.

I won a shiny blue jewel for first place. It was the best game ever.

My friends and I woke up really early. We wanted to climb the big mountain. My dog Max came and he chewed on a stick. The wind blew hard and it was cold.

We walked up the path and turned left. Suddenly we saw a giant bear! It looked mean and we were in trouble.

"Run back to the cave!" I yelled loudly.

We ran fast and the bear roared at us. Max caught his foot on a rock. I grabbed him and we jumped inside. We closed our eyes and waited.

"Is it gone yet?" my friend Sam spoke softly.

We looked out and the bear was sleeping. We were safe but we were tired. We went home after earning a good snack.

My friend Sam and I went to the old building. It was near the woods and looked scary. The wind blew hard and it was cold. I had to wrap my coat tight. We saw a long trail behind the house.

"Do you want to go inside?" Sam asked me.

"Yes, let’s go explore!" I said back to him.

We started to climb the big steps. A sign hung on the door but it was broken. We knew we should be careful. Suddenly a bat flew out and greeted us! We screamed and ran down the trail again. It was the greatest adventure ever, especially when we bought ice cream after. We were safe.

One day me and my friend Sam chose a weird adventure. We wanted to be like a brave knight in a movie. We went into the woods behind the old colonel's house. It was dark and my heart started beating really fast.

"Watch out for the monster," Sam whispered to me loudly.

I cleared the path with a big stick I found. Suddenly a huge bear walked out but it looked friendly. I dropped my bag and almost fainted right there. It wasn't a bear though, just a really big dog bearing a stick.

"Maybe he just wants a snack instead of us," I said.

I gave the dog my protein bar and he ate it. We slept in my treehouse that night. It wasn't a total failure because we saw a cool dog.

It was a hot Wednesday and the weather was super crazy. My friend Tom and I stood by the scary old shed. We heard a loud noise inside. Tom started running away but I grabbed his finger.

"Wait! We have to see what that noise was!" I yelled.

Tom was scared but he came back. We opened the door. It was dark but then a green light lit up the room. A tiny goblin was jumping on a pile of old books. He was reading a newspaper! He had brewed a smelly potion in a pot nearby. My heart was pumping so fast.

"Do you know about goblin psychology?" Tom asked me quietly.

"No, let's run!" I shouted.

We ran all the way home and locked the door. We never went back to the shed again.

I was digging in my backyard and I found a robot. It had a big red vein glowing on its metal arm. I felt a bad feeling in my tummy. My neighbor Billy saw it and ran over fast.

"Is that a space robot?" Billy asked me loudly.

The robot opened its eyes and they were bright green. It looked like it had anger inside it.

"We are in big danger," I told Billy quickly.

We searched for a button to turn it off. I saw a switch near its neck. I pushed it and the robot stopped moving. It was already thirteen minutes past dinner time. We ran inside before my mom started leaving to find us.

My dog Buster was sleeping in the meadow near my house. It was a hot day and he was wearing his blue collar. Suddenly a bunny appeared from the tall grass. Buster jumped up running fast but his leash got stuck on a chain.

"Come back here Buster!" I yelled really loud.

Buster barked and pulled but he could not move a single inch. I felt a cool breeze on my face. I walked over and fixed his leash so he was free.

"You have a small brain sometimes," I told him.

I gave him some water but not caffeine because that is bad for dogs. If he gets sick he has to go to the animal hospital. Exploring is important but we have to be safe. It felt like we were in a foreign land but it was just our backyard.

My cat Fluffy is usually very plain and boring. She just sleeps all day on the freezing floor. But yesterday she saw a huge bug. Fluffy jumped so high like she had no gravity! She crashed right into the lamp and it fell over.

"Oh no!" I yelled and grabbed the lamp fast.

My mom drove home right then and walked inside. The glass was scattered everywhere on the rug. Fluffy looked scared and crawled under the couch. She was making a sad groaning noise.

"Is everyone okay?" Mom asked with a worried face.

I told her Fluffy almost fainted from fear. I spent all night coaching Fluffy to be brave. We had a meeting with the bug later. I lit a flashlight and we found it outside. Fluffy hissed at it and felt much better.

I love playing basketball in the big summer league. It was an important game because my mom was watching. The coach blew his whistle loudly and the game started. I got the ball and I sprinted down the court. My heart was beating like a fast drum rhythm. I used all my strength and threw the ball high. It almost hit the ceiling but it went in!

"Good job!" my friend shouted at me while jumping.

"Thanks, I drank my dad's coffee for caffeine!" I said.

It was a beautiful shot and we were winning. We kept playing and I saw the net hanging loose. We won the game and got pizza after.

I was eating my lunch when suddenly I heard a knock. It came from the big tree on the playground island. Everyone stopped eating and walked over to see what happened. My friend Tommy scrambled up the tree to search for the noise. 

"Watch out!" yelled Tommy from way up high.

Something big crashed down and a green feather flew out. It was a giant parrot that appeared from nowhere! It screeched very loud and flapped its wings. We all struggled to catch it but it was too fast. It flew up towards heaven and grew smaller and smaller. 

"That was the coolest recess ever," I said. Then the bell rang and we had to go inside.

My friends and I went to the spooky forest. We wanted to find the lost treasure map. It disappeared a long time ago.

“Look at that weird cave!” said Max.

We walked inside and it was very dark. I heard a drip drop rhythm on the rocks. Suddenly a cold wind blew on my face. I stuck out my tongue. It tasted like dust.

Then we saw a big pot. A witch brewed green soup in it. We did not understand why she was there.

“Run away immediately!” yelled Sam.

We ran fast and we didn't look back either. We did not learn where the map was. But we were safe at home.

My friends and I reached the old spooky forest. It was dark, and a cold wind struck my face. We were looking for the floating gold coin. My brother said it was just a plain rock, though. We kept walking and tried to maintain our speed. Suddenly, I realized something was approaching us fast. It sounded big and scary like a bear!

"Run for the big tree!" I yelled loudly.

We sprinted as fast as our legs could go. I thought we were going to get eaten. We climbed up high and were swearing never to come back. But then a little bunny hopped out. We were earning a lot of scratches for nothing!

"It's just a bunny," my friend laughed.

We were safe, but we never found the gold coin.

I was waiting for the bell to ring for lunch. My stomach was growling so loud in the quiet room. Mrs. Green was reading a newspaper at her big desk. She always drank tea that she brewed in a pot.

"Is it lunchtime yet?" I whispered to my friend Sam.

"No, we have five more minutes," Sam whispered back.

I thought about the pizza they were serving today. Finally the bell rang and everyone swam through the door. The hallway was crowded with kids surrounding the cafeteria. I saw a balloon floating near the ceiling. It was the beginning of the best part of the day. We ate everything on our plates very fast. We wanted to maintain our spot on the swings outside. The playground was approaching and we ran super fast!

One day I found a weird metal box while cleaning my room. It looked like a foreign object from space. I opened the lid and a blue light came out. It was a tiny ghost robot! The robot floated up and screamed a loud beep.

"My mission is not complete!" said the ghost robot.

"I can help you complete it," I told him.

He was light and had no weight at all. He held a silver thread in his hand. We followed the thread outside to the scorched grass in the park. A spaceship landed right there. It was the beginning of a big adventure. The aliens brought snacks and we ate them. I never told my mom I almost sold the box. I will write about it in my diary later.

It was my best friend Sam's birthday sleepover. We climbed up the stairs to his attic to play hide and seek. I knew a super good spot behind some old boxes. I squeezed through a tiny gap and saw something shiny. It looked like a big red jewel on a dusty ring!

"Hey Sam, look at this!" I yelled loudly.

Sam appeared right next to me and grabbed the ring. Suddenly the lights flickered and the ring disappeared from his hand! Not a single person was in the room except us.

"Where did it go?" Sam asked and looked scared.

We followed a weird glow under the door but then we heard his mom. She had crushed ice for our sodas so we ran downstairs fast. We never found the magic ring again but the pizza was really good.

My big brother Max loves science and music. For his birthday, he got a shiny red guitar. He started jumping on his bed and playing loud songs. My dad walked in and his face looked funny. A big vein was popping out on his head.

"Please stop that loud noise right now!" Dad yelled.

Max didn't stop because he was pumping his fist in the air. Then he let out a huge sneeze. He climbed off the bed and moved to the floor. We were all hungry so Mom brought in the cake. We counted the candles and sang happy birthday. Everyone was cheering when he blew them out. It was a complete mess but still fun. Max said he will reign as the king of rock and roll. I hope he doesn't get a grounding for the noise.

We were having a sleepover at my best friend Sam's house. We were watching a scary movie about a monster on an island. Suddenly we heard a loud knock on the bedroom door! I was so scared that I screamed really loud. Sam gripped my arm hard because he was scared too.

"Who is that?" I asked Sam with a shaky voice.

"Maybe it is the monster from the movie," Sam whispered back.

Sam grasped the doorknob and turned it slowly. We were seeing a shadow moving through the hallway. The door opened and a big weight crushed us! It was just Sam's big dog, Buster.

"Oh no, unfortunately he wants to play!" said Sam.

Buster was steering us toward his ball. My mom says dogs don't know psychology, but Buster knew we were scared. Following Buster was way better than being scared of monsters.

I was playing my favorite soccer game on the computer for an hour. My brother Tim wanted to play too, but I said no. He tried to squeeze onto my chair and push me off.

"Move over!" Tim yelled and poked my arm.

"No way, I am winning this level!" I shouted back.

Suddenly the screen went black and I knew something was wrong. We lost the power because Tim pulled the cord. I was so mad I felt like I could bungee jump off the roof. Mom came in and blew her silver whistle.

"Explain what happened right now," she said.

I told her Tim unplugged it, but Tim said he was just reading the instructions. Mom made us stop and go do painting instead. I hate painting, but at least Tim didn't win either.

My brother and I were playing soccer outside. It was a really hot day in July. We were wearing our new jerseys and shorts. My dad was coaching us from the porch.

"Keep running fast to the goal!" he yelled.

I kicked the ball very hard at the net. It went right past my brother's hands.

"That is not fair!" my brother shouted loudly.

We played until it was almost thirteen o'clock. Then we heard my mom calling for lunch. I was so hungry from playing all morning. We ate roasted chicken sandwiches and drank cold water. Seeing the food made my stomach grow loud. It was the best lunch ever after winning.

My dog Rex is silly and he likes playing outside. One day I threw a stick and he chased it. He ran so fast he looked like a ghost. He crossed the big garden and found a muddy puddle. Rex likes dumping mud on the ground and rolling in it.

"Rex, stop getting dirty!" I yelled very loud.

He did not listen and his fur got heavy with weight. He looked like a brown monster now. I pretended I was a brave knight and he was a dragon. I rode my bike over to save him.

"You are a bad boy," I said to Rex.

My mom stewed some meat for dinner and the smell grew strong. Rex smelled it and ran inside before his bath was complete. He trained himself to always come for food. The reign of the muddy dog was over because Mom sang a happy song and washed him clean.

One day I was roaming in my backyard. I saw something floating in the big fountain. It was a frog! I called my nephew Sam to help me.

"Sam, look at this incredible frog!" I yelled.

"Wow, he looks like a champion swimmer," Sam said.

We pulled the frog out because he looked tired. He had a green vein on his leg. I discovered that he was actually very heavy. His weight was big for a tiny frog! We simply put him on the grass. He hopped throughout the garden and then hid under a bush. I drew a picture of him later. It was a fun day outside.

I was yearning for an adventure in the woods. My friend Sam and I walked to the beginning of the trail. The path was cleared but it looked scary. Suddenly we heard a loud moaning sound.

"What was that?" Sam screamed and grabbed my arm.

We saw a dark cave and something invisible moved inside. Then a big dragon jumped out and it was groaning loudly! Its tail was scorched and black. I threw a big rock at the dragon's foot. The dragon fell down and chewed on a stick. It was just hungry and sad. We found some berries and gave them to it.

"He likes them!" said Sam with a smile.

The dragon ate them fast and flew away happy. We were brave heroes that day.

Me and my best friend Sam climbed the big hill behind my house. It took an hour and we were very tired. Suddenly, we discovered a dark cave with groaning noises inside. My heart was thumping hard but I kept my legs steady.

"Let's go inside immediately!" shouted Sam. He grinned at me.

We walked in and it was simply beautiful with shiny crystals. Then we saw a big bear sleeping near a golden comb. The bear woke up and screamed loudly at us!

"Run away now!" I yelled.

We ran fast and didn't stop until we got home. It was the scariest day ever but the cave was cool.

Me and my friend Sam went boating on the lake. We bought a big raft for our adventure. Suddenly we saw a strange island and we rowed fast.

"Look at that big cave!" yelled Sam loudly.

We went inside and it was very dark and scary. I felt something bumping my leg and I screamed. It was just a fish but I almost fainted. We saw a man who looked like a colonel. He was clinging to a rock and looked hungry.

"I have been yearning for food," said the man.

We caught a fish and roasted it for him. The fire grew big and warm. He told us he simply got lost. We helped him maintain his boat and he was happy. We didn't bungee jump, but it was still cool.

It was my best friend Sam’s birthday sleepover last Saturday. We made a huge fort in the living room with blankets. Sam’s mom brewed some hot chocolate for us to drink. We discovered a box of old costumes in the closet. I put on a cape and Sam found some scissors. We cut paper stars and threw them in the air like magic.

Suddenly, Sam shouted, "Look out, the aliens are coming!"

I jumped on the couch and landed with a big thomp. We pretended the floor was hot lava on earth. The scenery outside was dark and sounding very spooky. I was yearning for some cake so we ran to the kitchen. It was the best night ever because we stayed up super late.

I believed the spooky cave had pirate gold inside. My best friend Sam gripped his flashlight tight. We walked straight into the dark hole. It smelled like wet dirt and old socks.

"Do you think we will find trouble?" Sam asked.

"No, we are trained explorers!" I grinned at him.

Suddenly, my foot got stuck under a big rock. I struggled to pull it out. The weight was too heavy for me. Sam pulled my arm hard. We fell backward and I scratched my knee.

"Are you okay?" Sam called out in the dark.

"I think so, though it hurts," I said.

We saw something shiny near the back wall. It was just a gum wrapper, not gold. We did not find treasure, but we still felt brave. Science class tomorrow will be boring compared to this.

Yesterday was the greatest day at school ever. We played kickball and I joined the big league. My friend Sam bounced the ball to me. I kicked it really hard and it went far!

"Run fast!" yelled Sam.

I ran to first base but I slipped on mud. Now I had a giant brown stain on my pants. I looked like a messy sailor. Although my pants were dirty, I was happy because I was safe.

At lunch, I was hungry enough to eat a horse. I opened my lunchbox but my sandwich was gone. It was like a ghost took it!

"Did you search under the table?" asked my teacher.

I looked and found it, but it was squished. I ate my apple instead. After lunch, the sky cleared up. My excitement for recess was growing again. It was a fun day.

One day my friend Leo and I went to a scary island. We went there for science class to search for rare bugs. The path was twisted and dark.

"I hear a weird whistle sound," Leo said quietly.

We followed the noise deep into the jungle. Suddenly a big monkey hung down from a tree. It grabbed my backpack and crushed my sandwich!

I screamed, "Hey give that back right now!"

The monkey ran away fast but we chose to chase it. We had a yearning to get my lunch back. We found a cave but it was too dark. We decided to go home because we were hungry. It was a crazy adventure.

My dog Rex is the greatest dog ever. We were playing outside in the big forest behind my house. Suddenly, a big brown rabbit appeared near a bush. Rex started thumping his tail really fast.

"Get him, Rex! Be a champion!" I yelled loudly.

Rex ran fast but he didn't catch the rabbit. Instead, he struck a big muddy puddle. Mud spread all over his white fur. I grasped his collar carefully so he wouldn't shake. Although he was messy, he looked happy.

"Oh no, now you need a bath," I said.

We walked home and I started cleaning him with the hose. It looked like a dog hospital in our yard. Rex shook and water went everywhere. We cleared all the mud off him. He is still my best friend.

I was playing my new knight video game on Saturday. I was waiting for the big boss to come out. He looked scary and was stamping his feet. He knocked me down and my health bar almost disappeared.

"Oh no, I am going to lose!" I yelled.

My brother walked in and started coaching me.

"Use the bungee jump attack now!" he shouted loudly.

I jumped and hit the boss and scattered his armor. It was a breeze after that and I won easily. The boss fainted on the screen. Then my mom came in bumping into the door.

"You guys need to search for your socks," she said.

We felt roasted because our room was a mess. We ran to clean up before she took the game away.

One day I was in science class feeling bored. Suddenly a green alien popped out of my backpack! He had three eyes and he chewed on my pencil. I screamed very loud and the teacher looked at me.

"Hey! That alien stole my homework!" I yelled.

The alien ran to the chalkboard and drew a big smiley face. Then he cleared his throat and started singing a weird song. Everyone started cheering because it was funny. But the teacher was full of anger.

"Get out of here right now!" the teacher shouted.

The alien winked at me and then he disappeared in a cloud of purple smoke. It was the best day of school ever.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old cave. It was dark and wet inside the big tunnel. We had to climb over some big rocks. I was trembling because it was scary.

Suddenly, we heard a knock deep in the cave.

"What was that noise?" asked Sam quietly.

"I think it's a monster," I said back.

We saw a twisted root growing from the wall. We had to squeeze through a tiny hole. My backpack got stuck for a minute. Sam helped me pull it out fast. We were keeping our flashlights on the bumpy path. Finally we saw the sun outside again. I was so grateful to be safe. We ran all the way home.
